A '''baked apple''' is the simple preparation of the [[apple]]. It heals {{Hp|4}} and grants {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} for 10 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/baked_apple.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Apples cook into baked apples in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in 5 seconds. Picking up an apple unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a baked apple takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|4}} and gives Regeneration I for 0:10.

Obtaining a baked apple unlocks [[Canned Apples|canned apples]] and the [[Apple Empanada|apple empanada]], which need it.

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== Advancements ==
* ''Powerful Flavors'': cook an intrinsic ingredient. Obtaining any of the 11 simple preparations of the ordinary intrinsic ingredients completes it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_food.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.7-alpha|Hot buttered apple renamed to baked apple, with a new texture. Canned apples and apple empanadas require it.}}
